title: Rect around a centre
prompt: Return a Rect2 of the given size whose middle is at center. The starter puts the corner at the centre instead.
starter:
func solve(center, size) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(center, size)
hints: Move the position back by half the size.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.

docs.name: a + b, a - b, v * number, v / number
docs.what: Vectors add and subtract part by part, and scale by a plain number.

solution:
func solve(center, size) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(center - size / 2, size)
